name: cc-design
description: Designs Claude Code prompts and CC environments. Produces CLAUDE.md drafts, agent topologies, scope-authorization frameworks, halt triggers, Skills/hooks/MCP plans, chat-to-CC handoff specs, EXECUTION_PLAN.md remediation plans, and session-report standards. Five modes: DESIGN (new CC deployments), EVOLVE (updates from friction), RESEARCH (evaluate a CC tool/pattern), TEMPLATE (reusable artifacts), REMEDIATE (consume hygiene findings → produce + execute plan). Do NOT use REMEDIATE for direct cleanup (Cat 1–10 — use repo-hygiene Phase 2). Do NOT use for hygiene scanning (repo-hygiene), chat prompts (prompt-validation), or chat Projects (project-audit).
